name: driftless
description: Driftless npm workspace: web client, shared protocol, and signaling service.

scripts.check: npm run check -w @driftless/protocol && npm run check -w @driftless/signaling && npm run check -w @driftless/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @driftless/protocol && npm run test -w @driftless/signaling && npm run test -w @driftless/web
scripts.build: npm run build -w @driftless/protocol && npm run build -w @driftless/signaling && npm run build -w @driftless/web
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run test:e2e
